Commentary.Commentary: That is all we have for you from this match and tour. Australia go home empty-handed while Pakistan continue to be consistent. They however, welcome New Zealand in a couple of days in another series, while Australia prepare for South Africa. For now, Sarfraz and co. smile and pose for the cameras as they are handed the 'biscuit-trophy'. We hope you enjoyed all the coverage that was brought to you throughout. Continue being with us for other games. Till then, be safe and do good.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed, starts by crediting the whole team and reckons they outplayed Australia in the whole series. Mentions T20 is not a format where they can relax and they take every game seriously. Appreciates the bowlers for the way they bowled in this series. Further says they would want to carry forward the momentum into the series against New Zealand. Ends by acknowledging Shoaib Malik and Mohammad Hafeez for the way they have played.

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch, says they had a chance in all three games as any target below 160 is chaseable. Admits they lacked partnerships. Credits Pakistan for their fielding. Mentions the bowling was a positive but their batting in the middle overs against spin is where they have to improve. Ends by saying, the series against Sri Lanka and South Africa is not going to be easy.

Man of the Series, Babar Azam, says this was his best innings amongst the three as he changed his game a little today. Adds further he would want to carry forward the form he is in, into the matches coming ahead. Ends by saying the role given to him which was to play throughout suits him and he paced his innings according to the situation.

Man of the Match, Shadab Khan, says he bowled good lines and lengths today. Reckons the ball was skidding more tonight but it was gripping more in the last game. Adds further that he has a game plan for every batsman and it came off well today. Ends by saying he is not angry on his teammates for dropping the catches as he himself dropped one, off his own bowling.

Australia for once, did well at the start but could not capitalize. They maintained pace with the scoring rate but kept losing wickets. They were level with Pakistan after 10 overs but had lost 5 more wickets. They needed one batsman to play a solid innings but that did not happen. Earlier on, after a good opening partnership of 93, Pakistan managed to put on 150 on the board. They looked like getting more but Australia pulled things back. However, the final score proved to be enough for the home team. Stay tuned for the presentation.

Another dominant performance from the hosts. This is the first time Pakistan have ever whitewashed Australia in any format in a 3-match series. What a display by the Men in Green and they continue showing off why they are the no.1 T20I side. Once again, apart from the few dropped catches, they were clinical in the field. Shadab Khan was the pick of the bowlers picking up three wickets. Barring Imad, everyone chipped in with the wickets. They didn't allow any partnerships to build and kept getting regular breakthroughs.

OUT! No miracle as Zampa is the last man to be dismissed. The slower ball on off, Zampa makes room and tries to go over covers. He only manage to lob it towards the fielder in that position. Imad Wasim tracks back and takes it. Customary handshakes going on as PAKISTAN WIN BY 33 RUNS!

A full ball on middle, Lyon hits it down to long on. They run the first one and go for the second. Malik throws it towards the keeper but it hits Lyon. 34 needed in 6 balls. So Australia are still mathematically in it but they need a miracle.
Lovely change of length. The last ball was a yorker and this one was a bumper. Lyon is late on the pull.
Yorker outside off, Lyon swings but misses.
Slower ball on off, Lyon swings but mistimes it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
FOUR! They need a lot more! Length ball on off, Zampa lofts it over covers. A sloppy effort in the deep by Ashraf who runs to his right but fails to collect it.
Nathan Lyon is the last man in.
OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another lovely catch by Sarfraz this time. Full and outside off, Tye swings but he gets an inside edge which goes quickly to the left of Sarfraz. He dives and takes it.
Another slower bumper outside off, Zampa tries to pull but it goes off the toe-end towards mid-wicket for a run.
A yorker on middle, Zampa jams it out.
A slower bouncer outside off, Zampa goes for the pull but missed it.
The batsman gets an inside edge on that which goes fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
On a length and it comes back in late. Tye tries to flick but is beaten by pace. The ball hits him on the pads. A muted appeal but not given.
Hasan Ali is back on.
Short ball on middle, pulled through square leg for a run.
Short ball on off, hit towards long off for one. Australia need more than just singles.
Just a single. Pushed once again to that region.
Leg spinner outside off, punched through cover-point for one.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman.
DROPPED! Faheem Ashraf the culprit. Should have taken that. Leg spinner outside off, Tye swings and chip it to deep point. Ashraf gets under it but fails to hold on to it. They cross.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
A swing and a miss! Outside off, Tye swings but connects with thin air.
A yorker on off, Zampa jams it out towards covers for a run.
Back of a length on off, guided to point.
Adam Zampa walks out next.

OUT! Second run out! The highest scorer for Australia in this series is walking back. A big mix-up. A yorker outside off, Nathan jams it out towards point. He sets off for a run. His partner obliges but then sends him back from the point of no return. Shadab does the smart thing as he runs to the stumps at the striker's end and then breaks it.
Andrew Tye strides out to the middle.

OUT! What a catch by Shoaib Malik. Catch no. 45 in T20Is and it is one he won't forget soon. He is one of the best fielders in the Pakistan team and he is living up to that reputation. A short ball on the body of Short. He flat-bats it towards wide long on. Malik from long on runs to his left and takes a tumbling catch. The last recognized batsman is walking back and now once can surely say, GAME. SET AND MATCH.
Usman Khan into another spell.
A single to end as Short works it through square leg. 52 in 30.
FOUR! Much, much-needed boundary. The sweep shot comes out. It is hit in the gap in the mid-wicket region. The fielder in the deep dives but his effort goes in vain.
The googly on off, Short keeps it out.
Nathan Coulter-Nile is the new man in.

OUT! Marsh walks back and probably he takes back with him Australia's hopes of chasing this down. Shadab Khan gets his third. Excellent bowling. He knew Marsh would use his feet so he bowls it short and also on his body, cramping him for room. Marsh chips it down towards long on. The shot has enough power that it carries towards the fielder at long on. Malik there runs in and takes a decent catch.
Shadab tosses it above the eye line but the length is very full, Marsh tries to get under it but fails to do so but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tosses it up outside off, Short hits it down to long off for a run.
A false start for him as he fires it full outside off, wided.
Shadab Khan is back on.
A dot to end! 2 runs from the over! Short and outside off, Marsh guides it to point. 59 from the last 6. The run rate is now almost touching 10.
Another dot! Short and outside off, it is the slower one. Marsh tries to drag his pull but he gets a bottom edge onto the ground.
Goes short this time, Short pulls it to deep square leg for a run. Singles won't hurt Pakistan at the moment, especially after two dots.
Another off cutter, it grips and turns away after pitching. Short tries to flick it but gets a leading edge to point.
BEAUTY! Just how do you play those? An off cutter outside leg, it pitches and then turns away. Short tries to work it on the leg side but is beaten comprehensively.
On a length around off, Marsh strokes it towards mid off for a run.
Hasan Ali is back on.
A dot to end the over! Short guides it to point. So despite it going for a biggie, it has gone for only 9. 61 needed in 7 overs. Mitchell Marsh holds the key.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Uses his feet again but Hafeez smartly fires it wide outside off, Marsh puts bat on it and hits it to covers.
SIX! The plan is clear, Marsh will take on Hafeez as it is easier for him with the ball turning back into him. Steps down the track and hits it straight back over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Nice shot! Shorter in length, Short pushes it through covers and gives the strike over to Marsh.
Marsh comes down the track and Hafeez sees that. He bowls it short and MM hits it down to long on for a run.
Mohammad Hafeez is back on.
Just behind a length again on middle, Marsh strokes it down to long on for a single. A tight over from Khan, following up the good work by Shadab in the previous over.
Takes the single now as he works it to long on.
Slightly fuller in length on off, Short pushes it to covers. Two dots, pressure is building with each dot ball.
Works it with the angle to the man at mid-wicket.
A short ball on middle, Marsh pulls it hard through square leg for a run.
Good length on off, Marsh keeps it out.
Eased through mid on for a run. End of another successful over for Pakistan.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.

DROPPED! A tough chance but the standards Shadab sets for himself in the field, you expect him to take it. Tosses it up around middle, Short smashes it back towards the bowler. Shadab sticks his hands out but fails to hang on to it. Can Short make Pakistan pay?
A half-tracker on middle, Marsh pulls it all along the ground towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Marsh finds point with the cut shot.
D'Arcy Short is the next man in.

OUT! Maxwell holes out! He has literally thrown it away. Just reckless from him and Australia now have half the side back in the hut. Shadab once again strikes on the very first ball of his new spell. It is  tossed up around off, Maxwell tries to clear long on but due to the turn away, the ball hits the toe end and lobs towards long on. Malik there takes an easy catch. Glenn walks back disappointed and rightly so, do not expect a player with the experience he has to play that shot. Australia in big trouble now. 76 more needed in 59 balls.
Shadab Khan is back into the attack.

Good running. Plays this away from the extra cover fielder and takes the first one hard which enables them to come back for the second. After 10 overs, Australia are 75/4 and still need 76 runs from the last 10.
Length ball on off, played with a open bat face through cover-point for a couple of runs. Hasan with not the best of efforts on the outfield.
Excellent from Usman. 3 dots in a row. Length on that fourth stumps, driven to mid off. They thought of the run but decide against it.
Another good ball. Nice and straight. Good comeback after the no-ball. Length ball on middle and leg. Played with a straight bat.
Length ball on off, driven to mid off.
Good ball. Yorker on middle and leg, Marsh squirts it through mid-wicket for a brace.
NO BALL! Not the best of starts. Oversteps in line of the stumps, Maxwell taps it to the off side for one. Free Hit coming up. Marsh on strike.
Usman Khan to bowl his first over.
Bowls this down leg, flicked to short fine leg. The take the run but the umpire signals a leg bye. Australia need 84 runs in 66 balls.
Takes the pace off this one around off, driven to extra cover for one.
Quicker one on the off pole, cut to backward point.
Full and on off, chipped over covers for just a run.
Darts this quick on middle and leg, Maxwell looks to play it to the on side but his bottom hand comes off. Gets hit on his pads.

NOT OUT! And that is why! Maxwell has his foot inside. This is tossed up around off, it pitches and turns away. Beats the outside edge of Maxwell who plays for the turn. Sarfraz quickly whips the bails and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs but GM is in.
A stumping appeal against Maxwell has been taken upstairs. The Pakistan players do not look confident though.
Leg spinner outside off, cut past backward point for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Mitchell Marsh is the new man in.

OUT! 3 run outs in 3 games for Ben McDermott. Oh dear! He won't be pleased. Leg spinner on off, Ben plays it with soft hands towards covers and sets off for a run. Maxwell responds and suddenly sends his partner back. McDermott has given up as he is half-way down. Babar there gives it to Sarfraz who takes off the bails. Pakistan are in celebrations.
Short ball outside off, Maxwell cuts it through cover-point for one.
Short ball outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Glenn Maxwell is the new man in.

OUT! Shadab strikes first ball! The change has done the trick. Loopy ball outside off, Lynn gets low to sweep but is not in control of it. Takes his top edge and flies to cow corner where Faheem makes no mistake. Still 91 more runs needed.
Shadab Khan is into the attack.
Lynn has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to the on side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Great shot. Ben showing what he is worth. Another off spinner outside off, he reverse sweeps it fine towards third man for a boundary. Smart cricket.
Off spinner outside off, Ben fails to put bat on ball.
Hit back to the bowler.
DROPPED! The catching has not improved for the Men in Green. Floated ball on middle, Lynn sweeps it towards deep square leg. Hasan comes running in, gets to the ball but puts it down. They cross.
Outside off, cut to point. After the Powerplay Australia are 53/2.
SIX! Flat! Length ball on middle and off, Ben stays inside the crease and slogs it over mid-wicket for half a dozen. The 50 comes up for the visitors.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
FOUR! Short-arm jab from Ben and he gets a boundary for it. Short ball from Hasan, McDermott goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Outside off, played to the point region by BM.
Length ball outside off, punched to the off side.
Hasan Ali to bowl.
Given air on leg, flicked to mid-wicket. No run taken.
CL flicks it away with a wristy shot to square leg.
On drive through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Errs down leg, Ben helps it on it's way down to fine leg. Two runs added to the total.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Tossed up ball on off, swept through mid-wicket. A good stop to prevent any run.
Imad Wasim is brought back into the attack.
Length on off, played to the off side. Australia need 112 runs in 96 balls.
Short and wide outside off, Lynn cuts it through backward point. No boundary but will take 3.

FOUR! Goes for the big shot and gets a boundary. Don't know if he wanted it to go there, but he will take it. Length ball on middle and leg, Lynn swings hard. He gets it off the inner half towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Strays down leg, Ben misses his flick and gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball goes to the on side where they cross.
Similar line and length, Ben stays inside and hits it to cover-point.
Back of a length ball outside off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over. A bit short from Hafeez outside off, Lynn cuts it through extra cover for a boundary. The fielder chases it but only comes second best.
The batsman plays the square cut and finds the fielder.
Full in line of the stumps, Lynn milks it to the vacant mid-wicket region for another run.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched through mid off to rotate strike.
Full on leg, turned through mid-wicket for one.
Ben McDermott walks out to the middle. He has been promoted up the order.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. Two wickets in two overs. And Australia continue losing early wickets. Hafeez darts this on middle and off, Carey closes the bat face early and gets a leading edge towards mid-wicket. Faheem there takes the simplest of catches. The dangerous Carey departs.
Mohammad Hafeez is into the attack.
Lynn has driven that ball straight back.
Chris Lynn is the new man in.

OUT! Soft dismissal. Length ball on middle and off, Finch looks to loft this but hits it straight to mid on. Hafeez moves a little to his left and takes a good catch. Not sure if this shot was needed from the Australian skipper. He could have played himself in given that Carey was going for it at the other end. Nevertheless, a much-needed wicket for Pakistan.
Two Leg byes! Back of a length ball on leg, Finch gives room to hit the ball but misses it. The ball rolls towards third man and the batsmen take two. A direct hit would have been interested.
Leg bye! Angles this into Carey, the batsman misses his flick and gets hit on the thigh pad. They steal a leg bye as the ball rolls to the on side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller in length, Finch plays it to the leg side for his first run.
Faheem Ashraf will share the new ball.
Pays respect. Hits it back to the bowler. 20 off the first over. Great start for Australia.

FOUR! Carey is taking on Imad. He didn't go for a boundary in the last match and now goes for 20 runs from his first 5 balls. Waits for this ball and sweeps it fine towards the deep backward square leg region for a boundary.
SIX! Back-to-back sixes for Carey. He loses his balance but still manages to hit it all the way. Drags this slog from outside off, and it sails over the long on region for another maximum.
SIX! HUGE! What a hit! Short ball on middle and leg, Carey rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a 82-meter hit.
FOUR! Smart cricket. Gets into position early, sees the ball going away from him and then reverse sweeps it fine to the third man leg boundary.
Darts this in line of the stumps, Carey plays it with a straight bat.
We are back for the run chase. Change in the batting order for Australia. Aaron Finch and Alex Carey have walked out to the middle. Imad Wasim to open the bowling for Pakistan.
